input.rationale: Governing law is acceptable at the preferred level: Section 18.3 (p0765) applies the laws of the State of New York. The forum, however, fails both preferred and fallback. Section 17.3 (p0744, p0747) makes every Dispute "exclusively resolved by final and binding arbitration" under the ICC Rules, and Section 17.3(a) (p0748) seats that arbitration in Osaka, Japan whenever Array demands it. That is mandatory arbitration that may be seated abroad — walk-away territory under this rule — and there is no court forum for the merits anywhere in the Agreement; Section 17.3(g) (p0757) preserves court access only for provisional relief. Because New York law is already in place, we target the preferred position: we convert the Section 17.3 forum to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County over the merits, retaining each Party's ability to seek temporary injunctive relief in any other court, and expressly disapply the residual tribunal machinery (while preserving the internal-counsel privilege protection in Section 17.3(f)) so no contradictory arbitration mechanic survives. The Expert determination track in Section 17.2 is untouched.

proposal.summary: Replace mandatory ICC arbitration (seat Osaka or New York) with exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, subject only to temporary injunctive relief elsewhere, and disapply the residual arbitration machinery; New York governing law in Section 18.3 is unchanged.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] New York law already governs under Section 18.3, but our position is courts rather than mandatory arbitration, and the current seat mechanic can place a Dispute in Osaka. We have replaced the arbitration forum with exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County over the merits, preserved each Party's right to seek temporary injunctive relief elsewhere, and switched off the residual tribunal provisions while retaining the internal-counsel privilege protection in Section 17.3(f).

ops.oldText: shall be exclusively resolved by final and binding arbitration as follows:
ops.newText: shall be resolved exclusively as follows:

ops.oldText: (a) Arbitration under the ICC Rules of Arbitration. The arbitration shall be conducted by three (3) arbitrators according to the ICC Rules of Arbitration ("Rules"), and the panel of three arbitrators so selected is referred to herein as the "Arbitration Tribunal." The seat of the arbitration shall be in Osaka, Japan, if it is demanded by Array, and in New York, NY, USA, if it is demanded by Ono, with hearings to held in the same location. The Emergency Arbitrator Provisions shall not apply.
ops.newText: (a) Exclusive Jurisdiction. The state and federal courts located in New York County, New York, USA shall have exclusive jurisdiction over the merits of any Dispute, and each Party irrevocably submits to that jurisdiction; provided that either Party may apply to any other court of competent jurisdiction for temporary injunctive relief. The remaining provisions of this Section 17.3, other than Section 17.3(f), shall not apply.
